run_mrp_setup: run an MRP setup script that defines multiple processes and starts them with mrp.main()
define_conda_process: define a named process that runs a Python script inside a Conda environment using mrp.Conda
define_docker_process: define a named process that runs a Docker container image using mrp.Docker
review_mrp_process: review the mrp.process function to understand how to define processes with name, runtime, cfg, deps, and env parameters
summarize_mrp_runtimes: summarize the mrp runtime classes including Conda, Docker, and Host for multi-process orchestration
